instruction: How to configure Argo workflow executor
output: kubectl patch configmap workflow-controller-configmap -n argo --type merge -p '{"data":{"config":"executor: pns"}}'

instruction: How to configure Argo workflow with artifact repository
output:
kubectl patch configmap workflow-controller-configmap -n argo --type merge -p '{"data":{"artifactRepository":"s3:
  bucket: my-bucket
  keyPrefix: artifacts/
  endpoint: s3.amazonaws.com
  accessKeySecret:
    name: my-s3-creds
    key: accessKey
  secretKeySecret:
    name: my-s3-creds
    key: secretKey"}}'

instruction: How to configure Argo workflow with minio artifact
output:
kubectl patch configmap workflow-controller-configmap -n argo --type merge -p '{"data":{"artifactRepository":"s3:
  bucket: argo-artifacts
  endpoint: minio.argo:9000
  insecure: true
  accessKeySecret:
    name: minio-creds
    key: accesskey
  secretKeySecret:
    name: minio-creds
    key: secretkey"}}'

instruction: How to configure Argo workflow with GCS artifact
output: kubectl patch configmap workflow-controller-configmap -n argo --type merge -p '{"data":{"artifactRepository":"gcs:\n  bucket: my-bucket\n  keyPrefix: artifacts/"}}'
